item.title: Correction · DataSF's Assessor Parcel dataset gives Chase Center (parcel 8722025) and the neighboring Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4 office towers (parcel 8722063) identical geometry: one shared master-condominium-association land parcel covering the whole Mission Bay South Blocks 29-32 superblock (Chase Center, both Uber towers, a parking structure and a small broadcast building are all separate condo units on one shared plat). That made the two records' shapes overlap completely on the map, so a click anywhere in the shared area could open either record, and each record's own location map showed the wrong footprint. Both now use non-overlapping shapes built from real data: Chase Center is the full Assessor parcel with both Uber towers' OpenStreetMap building outlines subtracted, and Uber Mission Bay 3 & 4 is the union of those same two outlines. Harmonic Brewing's standalone taproom building, at the northeast edge of the site (7 Warriors Way Ste 206 per its DataSF business-registration address; the registry's geocode puts Harmonic Brewing, Miller & Lux and Cupcakin' at the same point, so it does not place any of them in a particular building), and Miller & Lux (7 Warriors Way Ste 208 per its registration address; its position inside the arena footprint is not established by the registry) are both Chase Center/Thrive City tenants, not separate structures, so Harmonic Brewing's building is included in Chase Center's new shape rather than tracked separately. Re-matching business registrations against the corrected shape turned up three more Thrive City registrations: Cupcakin' Bake Shop (Ste 200), 'Siren SF' (1 Warriors Way Unit 24, shown as Siren Cafe & Bar) and The Sarap Shop (1 Warriors Way). These are registrations at Chase Center addresses, not proof of open storefronts, and each has its own entry.

item.title: Correction · Blocks 18B/18C corrected. A secondhand report that UCSF's own June 2025 CAC presentation (campus map updated December 2024) renumbers this row of blocks was independently checked. It showed that the building previously tracked as '18B' (a UCSF building complex west of Sandler Neurosciences Center, corrected 2026-09-20) is UCSF's 'Block 18C', labeled 'Open Space (Near term: Childcare Center)'. On review it was identified as the existing UCSF at Mission Bay Child Development Center (727 Nelson Rising Lane, operating since 2006), so 18B was renamed 18C, with the shape unchanged and the status changed to existing/interim ahead of a long-term open-space redesignation. With 18C's identity established, the 18A parking lot was extended east (~1,197 sqm) to close the access-lane gap that used to separate it from 18C, then re-split into new 18A and 18B of equal area, so the row now runs 18A/18B (parking) back-to-back with 18C (the existing childcare building). The childcare-center identification is an on-the-ground read, not independently confirmed by any source checked at the time, and is flagged as such in the record. A September 2026 accuracy check found that the UCSF deck cited (Dec 2024 map) lists Block 18C among 'undeveloped parcels remaining' with 'Open Space (Near term: Childcare Center)', which does not by itself show an existing building; no source read gives the 727 Nelson Rising Lane address or a 2006 start. The existing/interim status therefore rests on that on-the-ground read alone and needs a source.

item.title: Correction · Block 21 split into 21A and 21B. item.title: Correction · An assumption made earlier on 2026-09-22, that blocks 33/34 were unrelated to 490/499 Illinois St, was corrected: UCSF built three structures here where the OCII plan showed two. OCII plan block 33 is UCSF's Valley Center for Vision, a second, physically distinct building from the already-tracked 490 Illinois St tower of the same name, about 60-100m east across Illinois St; how the two relate is left as an open question, not asserted as either the same facility or unrelated.
